name: ohsms-server
description: WEHS/OHSMS API server: owns the WRITE path so authorization stops being Firestore-specific. Reads stay as client-side listeners governed by firestore.rules.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:attack
scripts.test:attack: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --config ../firebase.servertest.json --project ohsms-demo "vitest run test/"
